regime_context: The China A-shares detector is in a narrow one-narrative state: Coal leads with broad, one-narrative dominance but low durability and a mean-reverting tag; Banks is the lone challenger, now crowded (z=1.77). The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so this is a focus/attention lens only — directional conviction must stay low, especially given the 0.34 directional accuracy in the track record.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks (challenger, crowded z=1.77) confirms a leadership handoff by closing its 0.027 score margin over Coal AND broadening further — if Banks' breadth stays above 0.7 while Coal's durability_bar falls below 0.40 and Coal's ETF (515220.SS) underperforms Banks' ETF (512800.SS) by 3% over any rolling 10-day window, the one-narrative is genuinely rotating; if the margin reverses back toward Coal instead, retire the watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme other than Coal still eligible under the absolute-trend gate, has the highest durability_bar (0.80) and a trend-tag, and the strongest breadth (0.778) in the whole list — the rank-2 score is nearly tied with Coal (margin 0.027). Unlike Coal, Banks is not a mean-reverting tag, so trend persistence is more consistent with its character. The crowding flag (crowding_z=1.77, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a fade, but it does not invalidate the direction.
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded and the detector itself found the absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown on A-shares, meaning this market whipsaws trend followers — an overweight into a crowded, whippy tape risks underperforming if the mean-reversion character reasserts.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal leads the narrative ('one_narrative'=true) with the top score, but its durability_bar (0.48) is mediocre, breadth is narrow (0.30), and its hurst_tag is mean-revert — the leading theme is already showing signs of fatigue consistent with a mean-reverting tape. The avoid lean is a discipline call: do not buy the leader merely because it leads, especially when the one validated edge (trend-gate drawdown avoidance) did not hold on this market. This is not a short or fade.
theses.dissent: Coal is the dominant narrative with the highest absolute score and the only theme flagged with cash and weight — in a reflexive one-narrative tape, avoiding the leader can miss the strongest remaining trend if the narrowness actually means concentration rather than fatigue.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% by the 15-day check-by date
